notes: Assigned meaning layer. Editing this file never changes a stream assignment; it only changes how a decision is read.
Reflectivity is stored in permille (integer) so receipts stay float-free and hash identically in every language.

GOLD.label: Gold stream: Christ-aligned truth / fire-tested invariants
GOLD.surface_role: high-reflectivity coating; allowed to curve the central surface
GOLD.sentinel: green fish-person at the gold node

CYAN.label: Cyan stream: computable predicates / formal / testable
CYAN.surface_role: lattice: the geometric rigidity that allows reflection without distortion
CYAN.sentinel: green fish-person at the cyan node

RED.label: Red stream: discarded novelty / rejected / misaligned
RED.surface_role: reflected away or burned off; never enters the bulk
RED.sentinel: green fish-person at the red node

binary_continuous.gloss: Predicates and yes/no walls vs smooth fields, latent vectors, galaxies, rivers.

symbolic_material.gloss: Linguistic tapestry (words, code, equations, DNA as information) vs orchard, dogwood, flesh, photons.

tested_novelty.gloss: Fire-tested under contradiction, Scripture, adversarial pressure, elenchus vs untried novelty.

personal_impersonal.gloss: Christ as living covenant Word vs abstract Forms or Heraclitean flux.

fire_aesthetic.gloss: Survives the furnace (1 Cor 3:13) and bears fruit vs merely beautiful or sophisticated.

surface.thickness: zero: stateless boundary; the only state is the append-only curvature ledger
surface.curvature: aggregate of irreversible GOLD and CYAN decisions; RED never enters the bulk
surface.feedback: each emitted decision is re-sorted as a new symbol
